record.paper_title: Ordered Banach algebras and multi-norms: some open problems
record.context_brief: band and ideal images of representations
record.original_question: When there is a faithful or isometric representation of a Banach lattice algebra A in \({\mathcal L}^r(E)\) , what extra conditions on A are needed for the representation to be chosen so that the image of A can be a band (resp. \(\sigma \) -ideal or ideal) in \({\mathcal L}^r(E)\) ? In particular, is this always possible? Of course, the definitions of band etc. will need to be modified when \({\mathcal L}^r(E)\) is not a lattice.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $E$ be a (Dedekind complete) Banach lattice and let $\mathcal{L}^r(E)$ denote the space of regular operators on $E$, equipped with the regular norm and the natural ordering inherited from the cone of positive operators. A Banach lattice algebra is a Banach lattice $A$ which is simultaneously a Banach algebra and satisfies $ab \ge 0$ whenever $a,b \in A$ with $a,b \ge 0$. A representation of $A$ in $\mathcal{L}^r(E)$ is an algebra and lattice homomorphism $\pi : A \to \mathcal{L}^r(E)$; it is faithful if it is injective, and isometric if $\|\pi(a)\| = \|a\|$ for all $a \in A$.

Suppose that a Banach lattice algebra $A$ admits a faithful (respectively isometric) representation in $\mathcal{L}^r(E)$ for some Banach lattice $E$.

(a) Determine necessary and sufficient conditions on $A$ under which such a representation can be chosen so that the image $\pi(A)$ is a band in $\mathcal{L}^r(E)$.

(b) Determine necessary and sufficient conditions on $A$ under which such a representation can be chosen so that $\pi(A)$ is a $\sigma$-ideal in $\mathcal{L}^r(E)$.

(c) Determine necessary and sufficient conditions on $A$ under which such a representation can be chosen so that $\pi(A)$ is an order ideal in $\mathcal{L}^r(E)$.

In particular, decide whether such a choice of representation is always possible. When $\mathcal{L}^r(E)$ fails to be a vector lattice, interpret the notions of band, $\sigma$-ideal, and ideal in a manner appropriate to the ordered structure of $\mathcal{L}^r(E)$.
artifact.status_search_result: Web search results indicate that representation of Banach lattice algebras in $\mathcal{L}^r(E)$ remains an active research topic, with recent (2023–2024) work on band projections and order idempotents in Banach lattice algebras building on, but not resolving, the question of when the image of such a representation can be a band or ideal. No source claims a complete solution.
